text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer-san.
Let us do our best today as well.
choice_data_list: You're even more motivated than usual.
You're even more motivated than usual, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, actually, there is one thing...
Something wonderful happened.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"‘Dear big sister Ardan, how are you?’
...‘Back then’"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: "I'm sorry for telling you that you'd never be able to run back then, Big Sis."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"I saw Big Sis's race on TV!
Hey, you know what? You were super cool!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"I'll do my best with rehab too!
Then I'll grow up to be cool, just like you, Big Sis!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, long ago... a child who was admitted to the same hospital
sent me a letter.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...That girl found hope
in my running."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I was able to deliver a run that brought light to someone's heart.
I am proud of that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us go.
Bearing an irreplaceable honor...
within this heart, and upon these legs...!

That day, Mejiro Ardan puffed out her chest with
even more pride and dignity than usual.
